Kritter has an interesting concept, but it feels underdeveloped in its current state. There are quite a few bugs that can interrupt the experience, which makes it hard to stay fully engaged. Build diversity is also lacking — there aren’t enough meaningful options to experiment with, and some legendary perks don’t scale or function well in multiplayer. Because of this, all kritters end up feeling the same by the late game, which hurts replayability. Another frustration is the augment system. There’s no way to banish unwanted augments ( ex : YOLO )

This game is insane, you know what I'm sayin'. But I'm just stating the obvious.. About a 15 hour playthru, fun progression, great gameplay loop. Everything that should be fun in this game is fun, and it's a great time with friends. Highly recommend this game if you're into action roguelike coops.

Solid game experience, beat it in 4.8 hours which feels a little short. There is hardcore mode and you can say i didn't beat it which is fair for some users. but for me personally I've unlocked all the content and not too excited for hardcore. Needs more content at the hardcore point. Great Narration, Gets you a few good laughs, Fun core loop. 8/10

Game continually crashes when setting up for the third act. UPDATE: Don't know what the change was but I am now able to progress through the third act. Game is great with a friend, I can see the replay cycle being a bit boring after upgrades are unlocked. Hopefully more content is released soon.
Honestly this game is super fun. It has a goofy sense of humor and an enjoyable gameplay loop. Fully recommend, especially if you have friends to play with!
This game is great. Not only is it fun but the humor added in has made me laugh quite a few times. It is difficult but that is part of the fun.

Solid little game. A bit pricy considering I beat it in under 4 hours, but overall it was fun and hope more content gets added. There is still some unlockables and an endless mode so I'll be playing those, but fingers crossed for more upgrade options and game modes!

Kritter: Defend Together is fast runs mix exploration and base defense into a tight, replayable loop. Time reversal, class variety, and escalating waves keep every attempt fresh and strategic.

A chaotic mix of base defense and roguelite action where cute robots guard a sarcastic time-traveling ship. Gather resources, build traps and fight waves, then rewind time to return stronger next run.
